Query:

 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/dc95446cec0103510baf2ce04af00dd9402b7b265eebcb2308ddc544aee2fbb1/63aec5f9-1ac1-4956-bb6f-597cf72b60eb/' 
 WITH (format = 'PARQUET')
